audit_items.proof_trace: All four public liquidation entry points (`liquidate`, `liquidate_as_coin`, `liquidate_adl_borrow`, `liquidate_adl_deposit`) call `pre_liquidation_check` before any market state mutation, which in turn calls `ensure_has_permission` performing a correct bitmask check `(permission & (1u32 << what)) != 0`. Internal market functions (`handle_liquidation`, `handle_debt_auto_deleverage`, `handle_collateral_auto_deleverage`) are `public(package)` and cannot be called from outside the protocol package. `PackageCallerCap` cannot be forged externally since `mint_cap` is `public(package)` and the only external creation path (`mint_new_whitelist`) requires `AdminCap` and initializes permission to 0.
